summary: UC1: Console configuration — enable push on event creation
user_story: As a network admin, I want to configure whether a push notification is sent when someone creates a new event in a community, so that networks can opt in/out of event-creation pushes without changing the creation flow.
value_rationale: Allows network-level control and reduces accidental pushes while still enabling pre-event RSVP growth for activation-heavy networks.
preconditions: Admin has access to Admin Console settings
Push notifications are enabled for the network
entry_points: Admin Console → Settings → Push notifications → Event-related events

push_message.example: "Ulta Beauty Community has event Ulta Beauty World Masterclass 2026" / [In-person]  10 Jul 2026 · 7:00 PM
notes: {{EventType}} renders as a pill/chip label: In-person for in-person events, Virtual for virtual/livestream events
{{EventStartDate}} and {{EventStartTime}} refer to the scheduled start of the event (not send time)
The notification icon displays the community avatar

given: A network admin navigates to Admin Console → Settings → Push notifications → Event-related events
acceptance_criteria.when: The admin views the event-related events settings
then: They see a toggle "When someone creates a new event in the community"
They see a toggle "Notify whole network for events in public communities"
"Notify whole network for events in public communities" is disabled unless "When someone creates a new event in the community" is ON

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Whole-network toggle depends on event-creation push toggle
given: "When someone creates a new event in the community" is OFF
acceptance_criteria.when: The admin attempts to turn ON "Notify whole network for events in public communities"
then: The UI prompts the admin to first enable "When someone creates a new event in the community"

given: "When someone creates a new event in the community" is OFF
acceptance_criteria.when: An event is created in any community
then: No event-creation push notification is sent
The standard tray notification still fires to community members per existing behavior

given: "When someone creates a new event in the community" is ON
acceptance_criteria.when: An event is created in any community
then: A push notification is sent to all active, non-banned members of that community
The push deep-links to the event RSVP page

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Whole-network push allowed only for public communities
given: "When someone creates a new event in the community" is ON
"Notify whole network for events in public communities" is ON
acceptance_criteria.when: An event is created in a PUBLIC community
then: A push notification is sent to all network users who have push enabled
Group privacy settings are enforced automatically

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Whole-network push not sent for private communities
given: "When someone creates a new event in the community" is ON
"Notify whole network for events in public communities" is ON
acceptance_criteria.when: An event is created in a PRIVATE community
then: The push notification is sent only to community members
No push notification is sent to the whole network
